title: Buying a New Phone

title: The Music Was Too Loud

title: The Flower Parade
focus: Past simple; present simple for habits

lines.text: My favourite festival is the Flower Parade in my town.
It happens every August.
It lasts three days.
People make big pictures with thousands of flowers on the streets.
When I was twelve, I helped my grandmother make a picture of a bird.
We started at six in the morning and finished at midnight.
There is also music, and many people dance in the square.
The food is delicious. I always eat corn with cheese.
Tourists come from other countries, so the town is very busy.
I'm going to help again this year.

title: The Internet Isn't Working

lines.text: Thank you for calling Net Home. My name is Lucy.
Hi Lucy. My internet isn't working.
I'm sorry to hear that. Is the light on the router red or green?
It's red.
OK. Please turn the router off and wait for ten seconds.
Alright. It's off now.
Now turn it on again. The light needs two minutes to change.
Now it's blinking orange.
That's normal. Wait a bit more.
Yes! It's green now. It works!
Wonderful. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, thanks. You were very helpful.
